newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman ups UK stocks to overweight.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman ups UK stocks to overweight.

text.p: UK equities were raised to "overweight" from "neutral" at Lehman Brothers, a research note by strategists Ian Scott and Joe Rooney said on Monday.
The note said UK stocks look cheap relative to gilts, in marked contrast to elsewhere in Europe where shares look expensive relatative to bonds.
It forecast a 12-month return of 21 percent from the UK market, in terms of U.S. dollars, compared with nine percent for Europe excluding the UK.
This translates into a year-end 1997 target of 4,600 on the FTSE 100 index, the note said.
